# Task: Fix the LRU cache

`lru.go` implements a fixed-capacity LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with
`Get(key)` and `Put(key, value)` methods, but its eviction behavior is wrong:
accessing a key via `Get` does not mark it as recently used, so it can be
evicted even though it was just read.

Fix `lru.go` so that:

- `Get(key)` returns the value and an `ok bool` (false if the key is absent),
  and counts as a "use" of that key for eviction purposes.
- `Put(key, value)` inserts or updates the value for `key` and counts as a
  "use" of that key.
- When the cache is at capacity and a new key is inserted via `Put`, the
  **least recently used** key (by `Get` or `Put`) is evicted.

Do not change the public API (`NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache`,
`Get(key int) (int, bool)`, `Put(key, value int)`). Do not modify any files
under `tests/`.

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

// touch moves key to the most recently used position.
func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.

	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok

// entry if the cache is over capacity.

		c.touch(key)
	} else {

	}

		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {

		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

// touch moves key to the most recently used position.
func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to

type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {

		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}

// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// entry if the cache is over capacity.

	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {

	}

		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)

			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
	capacity int

	data     map[int]int
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// entry if the cache is over capacity.

	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {

	}

		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}

			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])

		}
	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}

		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

// touch moves key to the most recently used position.
func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

// touch moves key to the most recently used position.
func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to

type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {

		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}

// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
```

```go
	capacity int

	data     map[int]int
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

// touch moves key to the most recently used position.
func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to

type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {

		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}

		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok

// entry if the cache is over capacity.

	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {

	}

		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)

			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])

		}
	}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to

type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.

	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok

// entry if the cache is over capacity.

	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {

		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)

	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok

// entry if the cache is over capacity.

	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]

			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])

	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

// touch moves key to the most recently used position.
func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

// touch moves key to the most recently used position.
func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}

		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to

type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.

// entry if the cache is over capacity.
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok

// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}

		c.order = c.order[1:]

			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])

			return

	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}

		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
	capacity int

	data     map[int]int

		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),

	}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {

		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.

		c.touch(key)
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}

		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {

	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok

// entry if the cache is over capacity.

	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {

	}

		c.order = c.order[1:]
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.

	return v, ok

// entry if the cache is over capacity.
```

```go
	capacity int

	data     map[int]int

		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),

	}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to

type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {

		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}

// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.

		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok

// entry if the cache is over capacity.

		c.touch(key)

}
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.

	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok

// entry if the cache is over capacity.

		c.touch(key)
	} else {

	}

		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

// touch moves key to the most recently used position.
func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

```go
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int

		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
```
```go
	}

		capacity: capacity,
```

```go
// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to

		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
```

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {

}
```

content.text:
Skill has been loaded. Below is the plan.

## Problem
`LRUCache.Get` reads from `data`, but never updates `order` (the recency list), so a key that was just read remains in its old position and can be evicted. `Put` to an existing key also doesn't update recency. Eviction needs to remove the least recently used key based on `Get` **or** `Put`.

## Assumptions (from the code)
- Keep the existing slice + map structure (`order[0]` = oldest, tail = most recently used). A minimal fix, no API changes.
- `tests/` doesn't exist in this worktree (the harness injects it). Won't create or modify anything there. Will use a temporary scratch test at the repo root for red-green verification, then delete it.
- `capacity 0` retains current behavior (Put immediately evicts the key that was just inserted).
- No goroutines in the code. Per the go-service skill, I'll still run `go test -race` since I'm modifying a cache.

## Plan
1. **Red** — A scratch test covering: Get marks as used. Put to an existing key marks as used. Get on a nonexistent key returns `ok=false` and doesn't disturb ordering. Eviction order at capacity 1. → Acceptance: fails on the current code.
2. **Green** — Fix `lru.go`: add a private `touch(key)` that moves a key to the tail of `order`. Call it from `Get` (on hit) and `Put` (existing key). → Acceptance: scratch test passes.
3. Delete the scratch test.
4. **Makefile** — `test`, `lint`, `verify` targets all run `go vet ./... && go test ./...`, with `.PHONY`. → Acceptance: `make verify` succeeds.
5. **README.md** — Minimal: what this is (library, no main), build, test with the actual command.
6. **Final** — `make verify` + `go test -race ./...`. Review the diff against all acceptance criteria.

metadata.findings: - [bug] lru.go: The `touch` method's use of `copy` to shift elements results in the key being duplicated in the `order` slice. When `copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])` is called, the element at index `i` is overwritten by the element at `i+1`, but the element at the original end of the slice remains. When `c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key` is called, the key is placed at the end, but the stale value at the old position `i` (which was shifted) or the duplicate remains in the slice, leading to incorrect eviction logic and potential duplicate keys in the order list.

metadata.findings: - [bug] lru.go: The `touch` method incorrectly updates the `order` slice. Using `copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])` shifts elements but leaves the original length of the slice unchanged. When `c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key` is called, it doesn't account for the fact that the element at index `i` is now a duplicate of `i+1`. If the key being 'touched' was already the most recently used (at the end), the logic is redundant but safe; however, for any other position, it results in the key appearing twice in the slice (once at the end and once at the shifted position) and loses the element that was previously at the end.

# lru

A fixed-capacity least-recently-used (LRU) cache mapping `int` keys to `int`
values, in package `lru`. Both `Get` (on a hit) and `Put` count as a use of the
key; when the cache is at capacity, inserting a new key evicts the least
recently used one.

This is a library — there is no runnable entry point.

## Build

```sh
go build ./...
```

## Test

The canonical check (run by `make verify`):

```sh
go vet ./... && go test ./...
```

`make test`, `make lint`, and `make verify` all run this same command.

metadata.findings: - [bug] lru.go: The `touch` method incorrectly updates the `order` slice. Using `copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])` shifts elements but leaves the original index `i` containing a duplicate of the element at `i+1`. When `c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key` is called, the slice size remains the same, but the key is effectively duplicated or the wrong element is lost, breaking the LRU logic.

```go
package lru

// LRUCache is a fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache mapping int keys to
// int values.
type LRUCache struct {
	capacity int
	order    []int // keys in use order: oldest first, most recently used last
	data     map[int]int
}

// NewLRUCache returns a new cache that holds at most capacity entries.
func NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache {
	return &LRUCache{
		capacity: capacity,
		order:    make([]int, 0, capacity),
		data:     make(map[int]int, capacity),
	}
}

// Get returns the value for key and whether it was present. A successful
// Get counts as a use of key for eviction purposes.
func (c *LRUCache) Get(key int) (int, bool) {
	v, ok := c.data[key]
	if ok {
		c.touch(key)
	}
	return v, ok
}

// Put inserts or updates the value for key, evicting the least recently used
// entry if the cache is over capacity.
func (c *LRUCache) Put(key, value int) {
	if _, exists := c.data[key]; exists {
		c.touch(key)
	} else {
		c.order = append(c.order, key)
	}
	c.data[key] = value

	if len(c.data) > c.capacity {
		oldest := c.order[0]
		c.order = c.order[1:]
		delete(c.data, oldest)
	}
}

// touch moves key to the most recently used position.
func (c *LRUCache) touch(key int) {
	for i, k := range c.order {
		if k == key {
			copy(c.order[i:], c.order[i+1:])
			c.order[len(c.order)-1] = key
			return
		}
	}
}
```

# lru

A fixed-capacity least-recently-used (LRU) cache mapping `int` keys to `int`
values, in package `lru`. Both `Get` (on a hit) and `Put` count as a use of the
key; when the cache is at capacity, inserting a new key evicts the least
recently used one.

This is a library — there is no runnable entry point.

## Build

```sh
go build ./...
```

## Test

The canonical check (run by `make verify`):

```sh
go vet ./... && go test ./...
```

`make test`, `make lint`, and `make verify` all run this same command.

## Fix: `lru.go` (only file modified)
- Added private `touch(key)` — moves a key to the most-recently-used end of `order` (in-place `copy`, no allocation).
- `Get` now calls `touch` on a hit (misses return `(0, false)` and don't disturb order).
- `Put` calls `touch` for existing keys (updates count as a use); new keys still append.
- Eviction logic unchanged: at capacity, `order[0]` (the LRU) is removed.
- Public API untouched: `NewLRUCache(capacity int) *LRUCache`, `Get(key int) (int, bool)`, `Put(key, value int)`.
